# `app` — top-level routes

The routes outside `/api`: the backend's own status, Prometheus metrics, Design Center's HTML tools and the pictures social platforms fetch for a post.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/`](#get) | A liveness check: {"status": "Arynwood MCP running"} whenever the backend is up. |
| GET | [`/html-tools/{filename}`](#get-html-tools-filename) | One of Design Center's HTML tools from static/html-tools, framable only by the app itself. |
| GET | [`/metrics`](#get-metrics) | Prometheus metrics in the text exposition format (`text/plain`): HTTP request counts and latencies, plus the LLM and MCP tool-call metrics from `backend/services/telemetry.py`. |
| GET | [`/openapi.json`](#get-openapi-json) | This backend's OpenAPI document (JSON), built from the routes mounted in this process. |
| GET, HEAD | [`/social-media/{filename}`](#get-social-media-filename) | Serve an uploaded social media picture; api.py also serves it at /social-media/{filename}, the address the platforms are given. |

<a id="get"></a>
### `GET /`

A liveness check: {"status": "Arynwood MCP running"} whenever the backend is up.

- Handler: [`root`](../../../backend/api.py)
- Access: no key from this computer; the API key from any other

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `status`

<a id="get-html-tools-filename"></a>
### `GET /html-tools/{filename}`

One of Design Center's HTML tools from static/html-tools, framable only by the app itself.

- Handler: [`serve_html_tool`](../../../backend/api.py)
- Access: no key from this computer; the API key from any other; GET/HEAD allowed cross-site (the app's own media and frames)

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `filename` | path | string | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: a file, typed by its name

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 404 | Not Found | `serve_html_tool` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

<a id="get-metrics"></a>
### `GET /metrics`

Prometheus metrics in the text exposition format (`text/plain`): HTTP request counts and latencies, plus the LLM and MCP tool-call metrics from `backend/services/telemetry.py`.

- Served by prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- `200`: Prometheus text format

<a id="get-openapi-json"></a>
### `GET /openapi.json`

This backend's OpenAPI document (JSON), built from the routes mounted in this process. [`openapi.json`](../openapi.json) here is the same document with the opt-in routes included.

- Served by FastAPI
- Not listed in `/openapi.json`
- Access: no key from this computer; the API key from any other

**Response**

- `200`: the OpenAPI document

<a id="get-social-media-filename"></a>
<a id="head-social-media-filename"></a>
### `GET HEAD /social-media/{filename}`

Serve an uploaded social media picture; api.py also serves it at /social-media/{filename}, the address the platforms are given.

- Handler: [`serve_social_media`](../../../backend/routers/social.py)
- Not listed in `/openapi.json`
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- `200`: a file, typed by its name

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 404 | Not Found | `serve_social_media` |
